en: A vintage monochrome postcard showing a vast wheat field stretching toward low rolling hills in the distance. In the mid‑distance there appears to be a small cluster of farm buildings or trees. The sky is light and mostly empty. Printed red text at the top left reads "W. P. Reser's Wheat Field, Walla Walla, Wash." and there is dark handwritten ink across the upper right portion with numbers and words resembling catalog or registration notes.
